version: v2.6.0 known-gene recovery benchmark seed layer
purpose: Evaluate whether the current UGO module mechanism layer recovers expected known biological categories related to underground-organ development, regeneration, persistence, and structural remodeling.
benchmark_scope: category-level known-gene/family recovery, not single-gene functional validation
claim_calibration: Benchmark recovery is interpreted at category/module level. It supports credibility of candidate-prioritization logic but does not validate causal gene function.
